prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for three tiny mischievous creatures crawling out of a framed portrait on a black portfolio website.
Create ONE sprite atlas, exactly 6 columns and 3 rows, all 18 cells equal size, transparent background. Wide canvas 3:1 aspect ratio. Each row is a coherent 6-frame looping crawl cycle of ONE creature. Fully separate cells with generous transparent margins, each sprite centered and same scale, no grid lines or text.
Row 1: electric lime green #c5f33c little alien gecko with soft rubber body, big expressive black eyes, tiny hands with rounded fingertips, short tail, two tiny feelers. Side/three-quarter view facing right. Six sequential articulated crawling poses: reach right hand, pull body, tuck hind legs, extend left hand, push hind legs, settle. A playful curious art toy, not a real lizard.
Row 2: hot pink #f347a0 round squishy fuzzy little four-limbed creature, large white eyes with black pupils, small ear tufts. Side/three-quarter facing right. Six matching sequential climbing/crawling poses, alternating hand grips and tucked/extended feet. Short soft fur texture, clear readable silhouette.
Row 3: electric cyan #08bce9 small friendly squid-like creature with rounded bean head, large black eyes, four supple little tentacle arms. Side/three-quarter facing right. Six sequential flowing crawling poses, front tentacle reaches, middle arms pull, back arms curl and follow.
Style: premium playful 3D character illustration, restrained tactile texture, bright saturated colors, soft studio shading, strong shapes visible at 40px tall. Strange indie game companions, charming but not babyish. Full body every cell. No props, no floor, no cast shadows outside bodies, no framing, no letters, no watermark. Genuine transparent alpha background. Each row MUST depict the same creature consistently throughout its six frames, varying actual limb/body poses. Keep every sprite inside its own equal cell.
